depth_definitions.inspected: Content read in full or bounded selections. Not a guarantee of complete-file review. Tests remain unexecuted.
depth_definitions.family-supported: Leaf accounted through representative source/consumer/provenance chain; individual behavior or data content is not claimed inspected.
depth_definitions.metadata-only: Tree identity/classification only; contents unexamined and not presented as understood.

families.purpose: Repository instructions, host READMEs and operating guides distinguish thin hosts from shared application behavior.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Developers and maintainers; docs and repository skills are maintenance inputs, not shipped runtime logic.
families.maintenance_implications: Check current source before carrying forward performance, startup, error-copy or first-run claims. Keep main/preload/renderer and localization rules aligned.
families.evidence_limits: Guides contain intent and historical measurements. Shared shell and backend internals are outside this unit; guide assertions are not fresh product evidence.

families.purpose: Electron main owns launch/quit, initialization Deferred and the default authenticated CLI serve child.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Renderer awaitInitialization consumes URL/credentials only after owned health resolves; shared-daemon selector is an alternate branch.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve readiness/error forwarding, scoped state/cwd, output redaction, stop ordering and real child-close semantics. Stable-exit backoff indexing is an identified static discrepancy. The main-fiber failure observer logs, shows a hardcoded-English native dialog and exits; its visible copy conflicts with desktop AGENTS localization requirements.
families.evidence_limits: Source inspection only; startup timing, child reaping and OS behavior were not executed. The small mode test does not cover restart timing.

families.purpose: Window identity/state restoration, close flushing, navigation restrictions and recovery connect Electron windows to persisted per-window state.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Electron BrowserWindow, renderer unload callbacks, settings stores and OS window managers.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep window IDs independent, flush bounded to three seconds, sandboxed preloads, trusted renderer origin and recovery paths coherent. Full CSP is report-only.
families.evidence_limits: Fake-window tests were read but not run; display backend, multi-monitor placement and recovery dialogs were not exercised.

families.purpose: General renderer IPC wraps origin validation; typed preload exposes selected APIs; picked files use sender-scoped tokens and budgets.
families.consumers_and_boundary: window.api to Electron main; separate Dock, live, WSL and response handlers must be reviewed under their own admission policy.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve payload validation and native picker authority; do not assume direct ipcMain.handle registrations use the general wrapper.
families.evidence_limits: Preload/type leaves not directly selected are family-supported. No exploitation, Electron execution or complete all-channel audit is claimed.

families.purpose: Desktop Solid entry supplies platform adapters, storage, startup selection, first-run UI and a lightweight splash before shared AppInterface.
families.consumers_and_boundary: @orchestra/app shared shell and window.api; CSS/HTML support those entries.
families.maintenance_implications: Maintain ready-state gating, healthy remote recovery, per-window routing and shared-shell ownership. Main health ordering overrides the stale early-credentials renderer comment.
families.evidence_limits: Shared app implementation and uninspected small adapters are not fully verified; no rendered UI, accessibility or performance measurement.

families.purpose: Lazy electron-store state, bounded legacy cleanup, Tauri migration and SQLite draft/blob persistence provide different storage lifecycles.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Main IPC and renderer draft/storage adapters; WAL-backed documents and content-addressed blobs.
families.maintenance_implications: Choose userData before constructing stores; preserve transaction/flush ordering and inspect WAL-aware backups. Cleanup rechecks mtimes and must not delete nonempty state.
families.evidence_limits: SQLite assertions were read, including main-file-only copy negative control; no DB opened or migrated by this production task.

families.purpose: Local structured logging, crash/net logs, redaction and unresponsive recovery supply diagnosable failures.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Main process, trusted main-frame console, support ZIP export and user-facing recovery.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep remote page console out of trusted renderer logs; preserve bounded retention/export and redact supported text formats; never treat logs as instructions.
families.evidence_limits: Redaction module and OS sampler leaves have family-level support; no exported ZIP or real crash receipt was produced.

families.purpose: Native menus, external/deep links, app/path launching, onboarding, janitor and session-only keep-awake adapt OS features.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Renderer platform callbacks, native menus/dialogs, OS shell and powerSaveBlocker.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve typed commands, localized native copy, pending onboarding until project open succeeds, bounded report/snooze state and application-wide keep-awake broadcast.
families.evidence_limits: App detection, shell URI handling and individual menu helpers are representative family coverage, not tested OS integration.

families.purpose: Profile partitions, tab generations, active attachment, LRU capacity, popup policy, manifests and downloads own embedded browser state.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Renderer Dock IPC, WebContentsView and persistent browser sessions; remote pages receive no privileged preload.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve owner/main-frame checks, generation invalidation, revision CAS and profile tombstones; fullscreen is the explicit permission exception.
families.evidence_limits: Popup tests use fake Electron objects; not a browser sandbox or packaging proof. Per-profile storage contents were not inspected.

families.purpose: Serialized navigation and bounded page scripts implement browser snapshots, references, input, evaluate/network/storage and screenshots.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Dock agent RPC and current browser tab; numeric browser refs are distinct from native n: references.
families.maintenance_implications: Revalidate generation after awaits, expire observation namespaces on navigation, preserve JSON/script budgets and browser/native selector separation.
families.evidence_limits: Script strings are handwritten source builders, not proven generated artifacts. Individual interaction helper leaves and actual page behavior remain unexecuted.

families.purpose: Native protocol, admission queues, binding identities and helper channel manage scoped Linux accessibility requests and honest uncertain outcomes.
families.consumers_and_boundary: AppDockRPC, Docker helper channel and Python AT-SPI bridge; full runtime/session/binding/process identity crosses the boundary.
families.maintenance_implications: Retain admission reservations while teardown is uncertain, release only on terminal/reap evidence, distinguish not-dispatched from unknown, and prevent stale binding reuse.
families.evidence_limits: Memory-channel race tests read but unexecuted. Dedicated-container resource checks and real provider effects are not runtime-proven here.

families.purpose: Local Docker runtime metadata and lifecycle own the Xpra desktop, visible browser view, TLS viewer and guest session.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Main-only secrets/owner metadata to local Docker socket or named pipe; renderer receives runtime DTO and viewer placement.
families.maintenance_implications: Pin immutable container ID and local endpoint, reverify ownership before actions, keep ordinary workspace readiness separate from native readiness, preserve session file permissions and process birth identity.
families.evidence_limits: No Docker daemon, image build, Xpra/TLS display or integration test ran. Seccomp provenance is documented; its bytes, signing key and apt package closure were not independently authenticated.

families.purpose: Separate linux.rpc transport provides guest exec, bounded file operations and session-owned terminals with explicit cancellation.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Agent channel to verified workspace container; terminal owner/session and runtime start identity fence operations.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep cancel/reap and session-close ownership, output/input limits and transport termination distinct. Absolute guest paths are not a host filesystem sandbox.
families.evidence_limits: Guest process, file and PTY behavior not executed; source only establishes checks and intended authority.

families.purpose: Python AT-SPI helper discovers host-confirmed windows, fences process/ancestry identities, observes bounded trees and admits guarded actions.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Host native client over framed JSON; D-Bus/AT-SPI providers, X11 focus/pointer and keyboard helpers.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve explicit host confirmation, protected-field suppression, finite budgets, non-atomic observations and unverified logical identity/postconditions.
families.evidence_limits: Keyboard and bus leaves are family-supported by callers; no GTK/Qt/Electron UI, focus, mutation effect or timing claim was re-proved.

families.purpose: Windows distro manager verifies Linux CLI artifacts, starts authenticated per-distro sidecars and publishes typed runtime state.
families.consumers_and_boundary: WSL IPC/preload to wsl.exe/guest binaries and renderer server selection.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep generation fences, regular-file/hash/version checks, sanitized guest env and authenticated positive plus wrong-password health checks. Direct WSL registrations are separate from the general IPC origin wrapper.
families.evidence_limits: No Windows, WSL install, distro command or guest binary ran; shell quoting and every artifact replacement branch lack execution evidence.

families.purpose: Live orchestration owns capture, readiness, settings/key, audio conditioning, transcription and durable meeting/session delivery.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Hidden isolated capture renderer, OS media permissions, Deepgram WebSocket, authenticated backend meeting/session endpoints and main overlay state.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve source eligibility, one answer at a time, bounded audio replay, stable segment IDs and stop/flush ordering; direct live IPC needs its own admission review.
families.evidence_limits: No microphone, screen, provider, WebSocket or paid model call; backend endpoint semantics and consent handling were not independently audited.

families.purpose: Main-owned live overlay state, narrow preload and Solid view support answers, captions, navigation and protected always-on-top display.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Main live loop to overlay window; actions are filtered by overlay sender/main frame.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep overlay positioning/hotkey registration and source/answer state coherent; content protection requires platform verification. Overlay copy is separate English/Brazilian Portuguese, not the locale dictionary mechanism.
families.evidence_limits: Only representative renderer spans selected; full visual layout, all action transitions and actual screen-sharing protection are unverified.

families.purpose: Native save capability and renderer stream adapter transfer raw bytes with bounded in-flight writes and atomic final rename.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Renderer response body to native dialog, opaque handle, temporary file and user-selected destination.
families.maintenance_implications: Bind capability to originating main frame, maintain sequence/backpressure and distinguish cancellation before rename from final committed result.
families.evidence_limits: Tests read include foreign sender, malformed sequence and unowned temp collision; none executed. Platform native save dialogs remain unverified.

families.purpose: Manifest-bound CLI installation, shared daemon discovery, shell environment and optional Omni adapters provide executable/process boundaries.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Main owned/shared server, WSL and Linux access launch sites; core Omni/ripgrep/tree-sitter loaders are external boundaries.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve digest-target cache checks, companion resources, version equality, environment stripping and child exit-versus-close/backpressure semantics.
families.evidence_limits: Signature, version and process checks are source behavior only. Core native addon internals and all small environment fixtures are not fully inspected.

families.purpose: Electron build configuration and staging scripts lay out signed executable resources, platform installers and update metadata.
families.consumers_and_boundary: electron-vite, electron-builder and release pipeline; packaged runtime resolves extraResources outside app.asar.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep exact manifests/signature checks before and after packing, avoid post-hash executable rewriting, stage required notices and independent main/preload/renderer entries.
families.evidence_limits: No install/build/sign/notarization/update feed ran. Claude/Omni and metadata helper leaves are family-supported, not full script audits.

families.purpose: Main updater controller checks/downloads/persists ready state and stops resources before explicit installation.
families.consumers_and_boundary: electron-updater to subscribed renderer; unsupported self-update builds announce a release URL.
families.maintenance_implications: Maintain single-flight checks and authoritative ready state; persisted version alone is not acceptance of cached bytes.
families.evidence_limits: Mock backend assertions read; no network update, cache, installer or restart execution.

families.purpose: Desktop locale dictionaries and typed native message bridge provide host copy with English fallback.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Desktop renderer translator and shared desktop-native language contract; native messages reach menus/dialogs through main.
families.maintenance_implications: Update English contract and shared key validation first; locale dictionaries merge onto English. Keep live overlay separate copy visible as an exception.
families.evidence_limits: Representative dictionaries only; no translation-quality, key-parity or all-locale rendering audit. No generator is inferred for locale files.

families.purpose: Channel icon assets and pre-rendered splash media are consumed by platform packaging and renderer splash.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Native window/Dock/tray/installers and splash video/reduced-motion still.
families.maintenance_implications: mac-icons.py explicitly generates only macOS icon.icns/dock.png from a pinned official SVG/toolchain; other renditions follow their documented kit and copy path.
families.evidence_limits: No binary pixels, video, signature or original source kit authenticated. Tray/splash authorship is not established; do not describe every binary as generated.

families.purpose: Vite browser host supplies platform/default-server/token/draft adapters to shared AppInterface.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Browser storage/Notification/external navigation and backend HTTP origin; shared shell owns product screens.
families.maintenance_implications: Preserve auth_token removal from address bar and selected-server behavior, allowed external schemes and optional Sentry/sourcemap handling.
families.evidence_limits: No browser run; CLI serving and production origin deployment are documented boundary intent, not independently verified implementation.

families.purpose: Generator renders a handwritten invariant register into four consolidated and per-invariant Markdown artifacts.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Maintainers and reviewers of historic Dock requirements/goldens/cards; no runtime consumer observed.
families.maintenance_implications: Edit/check generator literals and actual cited tests together; emitted measured/ready labels are not execution receipts.
families.evidence_limits: Representative outputs read. Generator not run and every historical test line reference not revalidated; source golden files are not reserved Genesis judges/oracles.

families.purpose: Dated Dock accessibility/Linux campaigns, contracts, handoffs and desktop brief record design and prior closure claims.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Historical implementation planning and maintenance context, subordinate to current source and task authority.
families.maintenance_implications: Retain dates/baselines and incomplete production boundaries; never carry historical PASS or requested future API forward as present proof.
families.evidence_limits: Representative historical documents inspected; other leaves are family-supported, not read assertions or instructions followed.

families.purpose: Development-only native images, probes, scenario/contract fixtures and assertion suites support real-provider validation.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Developer proof environment for GTK/Qt/Electron, native helper and independent filesystem/config effects.
families.maintenance_implications: Retain environment/version/image receipts, process birth identity and independent effects; setup success does not prove semantics and dev flags are not production policy.
families.evidence_limits: No probes, fixtures, Docker recipes or Python/product tests executed. Most harness leaves are purpose/family supported, not individually audited.

families.purpose: Packaged Electron smoke matrix distinguishes production shutdown cells from diagnostic and mutation controls.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Packaged Electron proof harness and isolated process/keychain/LLM fixtures.
families.maintenance_implications: Verify actual packaged provenance, live process counts and ownership before crash/quit; emergency cleanup cannot stand for an observed shutdown pass.
families.evidence_limits: Matrix entry/control assertions inspected, supporting harness leaves family-supported. No packaged run or mutation control was executed.

families.purpose: Operator scripts and standalone proof entrypoints drive Dock/Linux runtime or WSL transport for development checks.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Developer CLI/manual proof drivers; production runtime modules supply the semantic boundary.
families.maintenance_implications: Keep proof configuration isolated and label actual source/runtime identities; scripts may create containers/processes and must not be mistaken for receipts.
families.evidence_limits: Scripts captured where available but not fully selected; family-level purpose only, no execution or command-level assurance.

families.purpose: Workspace/toolchain declarations and ignore rules support desktop build, tests and dependency/type resolution.
families.consumers_and_boundary: Build/test tooling; Node SQLite tests differ from Bun tests by source declaration.
families.maintenance_implications: Maintain cross-platform artifact targets and entrypoint/alias consistency. Configuration existence does not establish a passing build.
families.evidence_limits: Uncaptured config/ignore leaves are metadata-only; no dependency resolution or effective compiler configuration audit.
